title: Lights — Passenger Compartment — Conversion of Ceiling Luminaires to a Continuous LED Strip

ata.title: Passenger Compartment Lighting — Ceiling and Wall Wash Lights

abstract: Replacement of the eleven segmented ceiling luminaires per side by one continuous LED strip in a moulded channel, cutting cabin lighting removals and removing the scalloped ceiling appearance.

sections.planning_reason: The segmented ceiling luminaire arrangement produces a visible scalloped pattern on the ceiling that three operators have raised as a cabin appearance issue, and the individual segments fail at about eleven per aircraft per year, driven by the connector at each segment joint rather than by the light engines. Cabin lighting is the second most common cabin defect on the type. Reducing eleven joints per side to one removes the failure mode rather than improving the connector.
sections.description: The eleven ceiling luminaire segments per side are replaced by a single continuous LED strip carried in an extruded channel moulded into a new ceiling panel, with one power and control connection at each end.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the cabin ceiling and wall wash panels along the full cabin length in zones 265, 275 and 293. Disconnect and remove the eleven luminaire segments per side and their inter-segment connectors. Install the ceiling panel D3320113544835 with the moulded channel at each position and the re-profiled wall wash panel D3320114693851 beside it, securing both with shear head bolts LN983579-8C to the ceiling former. Feed the LED strip into the channel from the forward end and retain it with the curtain rail sections ESC169948-27 at the pitch given in the accomplishment instructions. Make the power and control connections at each end only and cap the redundant inter-segment harness branches. Do the cabin lighting functional check at every brightness setting and confirm no visible scalloping. Do the emergency lighting independence check. Install the remaining panels and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft MSN C00001 through C00585 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00591 onward carry the continuous strip from build. A partial cabin conversion is permitted but is not recommended, because the two arrangements differ visibly at the boundary.
sections.material_note: Kit K3320-1005-01 covers a full cabin and contains the ceiling and wall wash panels, two LED strips, the retaining rail sections and the fastener set. Lead time is thirty weeks. Segmented luminaires remain available as spares for aircraft that stay at the previous standard.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next cabin refresh, or at the operator's discretion.
